neighbours.label: the token ' top' as the upper part or as the first half of a compound (the top of, on top of, top-down, topwater)
fire: He climbed the ladder and stood at the very top of the silo.
The shelf has a top and a bottom panel made of pine.
The company used a top-down approach to cut costs.
Anglers love throwing a topwater popper over the weeds.
The line drive bounced off the top of the scoreboard.
On top of the fees, the bank added a penalty.
Her new oven is a top-loading unit with a glass lid.
The gardener applied a top dressing of compost to the beds.
quiet: He climbed the ladder and stood at the very edge of the silo.
The shelf has a left and a right panel made of pine.
The company used a gradual approach to cut costs.
Anglers love throwing a heavy jig over the weeds.
The line drive bounced off the side of the scoreboard.
Besides the fees, the bank added a penalty.
Her new oven is a wall-mounted unit with a glass door.
The gardener applied a thin layer of compost to the beds.

notes: ' top' is 16 of the top 32. The rest are mixed: ' on' before 'the table' reached 0.50 and other tokens also appear, so coverage may be partial. 'Top athletes' reached only 0.16, so the ranking sense is weak.
